summary: Turn any sales call into a polished follow-up doc in seconds.

useCases.title: Auto-generate a sales call leave-behind
useCases.message: Help me put together a follow-up doc after a sales call. Ask me who the meeting was with and when. Then go find the context yourself: check the calendar invite, our email history, and their CRM record. Draft a short doc covering what was discussed, what was agreed, and next steps. Ask me if I want to email it when it's ready.
